description: ERC20 Transfer events for a token and/or wallet via eth_getLogs, decoded (from, to, amount with decimals, tx hash, block). Default last 100 blocks, max 5000. Public RPCs need a contract filter: pass token=; if only wallet address is given, known chain tokens (USDC/WETH/…) are scanned. Example: {token:"0x8335…2913", address:"0x88b1…3ff6", chain:"base"}. $0.003 USDC.
name: chain_erc20_transfers
